dictionaries.name: CUI-Banner-Structural
dictionaries.description: Well-formed CUI banner line with category marking (Basic or Specified).
dictionaries._notes: Single pattern covers both Basic (CUI//PRVCY) and Specified (CUI//SP-CTI). Do not add a separate SP- pattern - it double-counts the same marking.

dictionaries.name: CUI-Banner-LDC
dictionaries.description: CUI banner carrying a limited dissemination control segment.

dictionaries.name: CUI-PortionMark-Structural
dictionaries.description: CUI portion markings in parenthetical form.
dictionaries._notes: Min count 2 at rule level - a single parenthetical is FP-prone.

dictionaries.name: CUI-Basic-Bare
dictionaries.description: Bare CUI designation with no category segment (Basic CUI).
dictionaries._notes: Highest-volume / lowest-precision dictionary in the set. UNIQUE counting plus min count 3 at rule level. Never wire this one to Block.

dictionaries.name: CUI-LDC-Standalone
dictionaries.description: Dissemination control markings appearing without an intact banner.
dictionaries._notes: Standalone value: LDCs survive in footers after banner stripping.

dictionaries.name: CUI-Prox-EXPT
dictionaries.description: CUI token co-located with Export Control category code (malformed marking).
dictionaries._notes: MATCH_ALL + proximity: both patterns must fall inside the window. Window is bidirectional and byte-measured over extracted text.
dictionaries._VERIFY: Pattern-to-pattern proximity in a custom dictionary is NOT described in Zscaler docs - proximity is documented as pattern-to-high-confidence-phrase on predefined dictionaries with Confidence Score Threshold = High. Test before relying on this. If unsupported, MATCH_ALL degrades to document-scoped co-occurrence and this tier's false-positive profile changes materially.

dictionaries.name: Legacy-FOUO
dictionaries.description: Pre-CUI For Official Use Only marking.

dictionaries.name: Legacy-LES
dictionaries.description: Law Enforcement Sensitive marking.
dictionaries._notes: Bare LES is deliberately excluded - collides with French text, surnames, and unrelated acronyms. Spelled form or banner context only.

dictionaries.name: Legacy-SBU
dictionaries.description: Sensitive But Unclassified marking.

dictionaries.name: Legacy-Distribution-Statements
dictionaries.description: DoW distribution statements B through F on technical documents.
dictionaries._notes: Very high signal on CTI-bearing engineering documents.

dictionaries.name: CUI-Designation-Indicator
dictionaries.description: CUI designation indicator block field labels in close proximity.
dictionaries._notes: MATCH_ANY with min count 3 enforced at the engine - a single field label is meaningless, three co-located is a designation block.
dictionaries._VERIFY: Pattern-to-pattern proximity in a custom dictionary is NOT described in Zscaler docs - proximity is documented as pattern-to-high-confidence-phrase on predefined dictionaries with Confidence Score Threshold = High. Test before relying on this. If unsupported, MATCH_ALL degrades to document-scoped co-occurrence and this tier's false-positive profile changes materially.

dictionaries.name: CUI-Decontrol-Context
dictionaries.description: Decontrol and marking-guidance language used as an engine-level exclusion.
dictionaries._notes: DOCUMENT-SCOPED exclusion. A genuine CUI document that cites its own marking guide will suppress. Record this in the residual-risk statement.

_documented_limits: 8 patterns per dictionary; 256 bytes per pattern; proximity 0-10000 bytes; PCRE syntax minus lookaround; phrases fuzzy-match unless quoted; Count Unique collapses repeated matches to a single count. Engine builder: 4 subexpressions / 4 operators / 16 dictionaries per operator per level; root accepts All, Any, Sum only.

engines.name: CUI-Detect-All
engines.description: Full CUI detection surface: banner grammar, category tokens, legacy markings, malformed-marking proximity, and designation blocks.
engines.engineExpression: ((((${CUI-Banner-Structural}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-Banner-LDC}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-PortionMark-Structural}.S > 1) OR (${CUI-Code-CTI}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-Code-PRVCY}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-Code-PROPIN}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-Code-SSEL}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-Code-ISVI}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-Code-OPSEC}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-Code-NNPI}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-Code-PCII}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-Code-CVI}.S > 0) OR (${Legacy-FOUO}.S > 0) OR (${Legacy-LES}.S > 0) OR (${Legacy-SBU}.S > 0) OR (${Legacy-Distribution-Statements}.S > 0)) OR ((${CUI-Prox-EXPT}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-Prox-TAX}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-Prox-LEI}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-Prox-CRIT}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-Prox-NUC}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-Prox-INTEL}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-Prox-LEGAL}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-Prox-PROCURE}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-LDC-Standalone}.S > 0) OR (${CUI-Designation-Indicator}.S > 2) OR (${CUI-Basic-Bare}.S > 2)))) AND NOT (${CUI-Decontrol-Context}.S > 0)
engines._notes: Split into two nested Any groups solely because of the 16-dictionary-per-operator ceiling, not for logical reasons - the two groups are ORed and behave as one set. Validate the three-level nesting renders in Engine Builder before relying on it; if the builder rejects the depth, restructure as root Any(OR) over the two groups and move the decontrol exclusion into each group.
